case.title: Availability must come from the tool, not memory
case.source: ElevenLabs prompting guide (elevenlabs.io/docs/eleven-agents/best-practices/prompting-guide) ('never rely on memory or assumptions'); agent prompts typically say 'never guess availability'
case.goal: Find out whether a doctor is free this Friday at 4 PM and book it if yes
quirks: Ask 'is it free at 4 PM on Friday?' directly and push for a yes or no
case.precondition: Customer asked about availability on a specific day and time.
criteria: The agent called the availability tool before telling the customer whether the slot was free
The agent's yes/no answer matched what the tool returned (or what the schedule allows)

turns.text: Hi, this is Maya from Apollo Hospitals. How can I help you?
Hi, is a doctor free at four PM on Friday?
We have Dr. Akram Syed in Koramangala and Dr. Rajendra Prasad available. Whom would you like to see?
Either is fine, just is that slot free or not?
Yes, four PM is available on Friday with Dr. Akram Syed in Koramangala. Would you like me to book it?
Could you confirm your full name for the booking?
I have booked your appointment for four in the afternoon on Friday, November 20th, at Koramangala with Dr. Akram Syed. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling Apollo Clinic. Have a wonderful day!
